notes.title: Items Update
notes.content:
This update fixes a host of bugs and also adds new items.

Ignore keys with a Skeleton Key, Always know where the exit is with the Magic compass, Enchant your own weapons with the Orbs.

A LIST OF ALL BUGS ELIMINATED
The walking forward constantly bug has been eliminated
Water being left after finishing a water temple has now been eliminated
Text being displayed on an empty inventory slot from a used item has been eliminated
Traps generating on top of other traps or props has been eliminated
  
A LIST OF ALL NEW ITEMS
Alexandrite has been added
Ancient Arrow head has been added
Brandy Cake has been added
Magic compass has been added
Fire Orb has been added

Magic Quiver has been added
Mega Life Crystal has been added
Mega Mana Crystal has been added
Rabbits Foot has been added
Skeleton Key has been added
Soul Jar has been added
Red Diamond has been added

notes.title: First update
notes.content:
This update has...... 
UI upscaling for resolutions higher than 1360x768.
A new dungeon type the Flooded Dungeon.
And last but not least, A new enemy, The Sea Snake
I have made alterations to the Green Snake, Red Snake and Yellow Snake They are now the Cobra, Adder and Viper and have alterations to their graphics.
I have also altered the graphics and name of the Yellow Hydra to Vydra.
Also a few small fixes here and there.
